templates.welcome: Hi {name}! 👋 I'm DLLMaster Bot 🎵 🎧 What can I do? 🔎 Type a song name or /music name — I'll find and download it 🔗 Send a YouTube / Spotify link, playlist or album ⚡ In any chat: @{bot} song name 🔀 /mix name or the Mix button under a song — similar songs ⏹ You can stop a download at any time ✏️ Send me an audio — I'll change its title, artist and cover {status} Bot created by @{creator} 🚀
templates.group: Hello, {group}! 👋 {thanks}I'm DLLMaster Bot 🎵 🎧 How to use me in a group? 🔎 /music song name — I'll find and download it ⚡ @{bot} song name — send with one tap 🔗 YouTube / Spotify playlist, album or track link 🔀 /mix song name — similar songs {rights} Bot created by @{creator} 🚀
templates.download: 🎵 How to download a song? 1️⃣ Type the song name, e.g. Miri Yusif Qarabag or /music song name 2️⃣ Pick the song from the list 3️⃣ The song arrives in a few seconds 🎧 🔗 Links work too: YouTube, Spotify track, playlist and album ⏹ Cancel any time with Stop download 🔀 /mix song name — list of similar songs (or reply /mix to a song the bot sent) 🙈 Hide — hides the buttons under the song
templates.inline: 🔎 Inline search Send songs in any chat without adding the bot: 1️⃣ In the message field type: @{bot} song name 2️⃣ Pick the song from the list 3️⃣ The song goes to that chat 🎧 🔀 Use Mix under a song to send similar songs the same way. 👇 Tap the button to try it
templates.tip: ⭐ Send a tip If you like DLLMaster, you can support the work with a Telegram Stars tip 💙 Tips help cover the server, the storage channel and new features. 👇 Pick an amount or type your own:
templates.edit: ✏️ Edit song metadata 1️⃣ Send me any song (audio file) 2️⃣ Choose in the panel: ✏️ Title — song title 🎤 Artist — performer name 🖼 Thumbnail — cover image 3️⃣ Tap ✅ Send — the edited song comes back ℹ️ The file must be under 20 MB (Telegram limit).
